dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should probably write a message. Citlali might not even notice them in all this mess.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Paimon finds a piece of paper and thinks for a moment before writing a note.

dialogues.speaker: Check Note
dialogues.text: (Citlali, we found the books you were looking for. You were sleeping when we got here and we didn't want to wake you.)

dialogues.speaker: Check Note
dialogues.text: (Maybe drink a little less next time, eh?)
